name: Printer Provisioning
description: Windows MDM settings in the Printer Provisioning category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Cloud Device ID (User)
properties.description: Identifies the Universal Print printer, by its Printer ID, you wish to install on the targeted user account. The printer's Printer ID can be found in the printer's properties via the Universal Print portal. Note: the targeted user account must have access rights to both the printer and to the Universal Print service.

properties.name: Error code (User)
properties.description: Univeral Print printer installation error code.
